purpose: Assign every inventoried manuscript to exactly one of development, judge_calibration, fenced_validation or excluded. Papers, not runs, are the sampling unit. fenced_validation cases must not be run, judged, extracted or inspected before the single human validation.
target_population: Ordinary empirical quantitative social-psychology submissions (experiments, surveys, replications) with an exact first-round submitted version and all public first-round reports. Methodological, tutorial, meta-research, psychometric, Stage 2 registered-report and planted-error cases are reported separately by genre.

splits.development: Iterate freely; includes every previously exposed case.
splits.judge_calibration: Use only to calibrate the judge and judge-human agreement; do not tune the reviewer pipeline on these cases.
splits.fenced_validation: Never used before the single human validation. Run drivers call eval/check_fence.py.

split_rule.fence_eligibility: Verified exact first-round submission with all first-round reports retrievable; ordinary empirical (experiment, survey, replication) in social/personality psychology or social-attitude research; licence permits local research use; never run by any review configuration, never used in judge calibration, and not purposively curated or quality-screened.
procedure: Eligibility and stratum (journal family) were frozen from metadata and version checks before the draw, without inspecting AI output or rating review quality.
Within each fence_draw stratum, rank cases by sha256(seed|id); the first ceil(fenced_fraction * n) are fenced_validation; the remainder alternate judge_calibration, development.
Verified cases that are not fence-eligible (methodological, adjacent-domain or Stage 2 registered reports) are ranked the same way within their stratum and alternate development, judge_calibration.

Previously exposed cases, the owner-designated curated Meta-Psychology training/development corpus (2026-10-05) and the owner paper are development; cases without a usable submitted version, licence or complete report set are excluded. These fixed assignments carry a reason.

fence_guard: eval/check_fence.py refuses (exit 3) any manuscript or run directory containing a fenced file hash, recorded hash, source URL, case ID, or (in generation inputs) DOI/title. Raw fenced downloads live only in the ignored eval/corpus/fenced/.
